headline: GlobalFoundries Stock Costs More Than The Market On Earnings And Less On Cash Flow
summary: The chipmaker looks dear on profits and slightly cheap on cash, and what sits under that gap is a business that turns far more of each sales dollar into cash than into profit while it swaps a shrinking handset exposure for faster end markets in data centers and automotive.
